method: Deep-research replay derived from the already-frozen 2021Q3 event set. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff regime snapshots are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before deep memos lock.
Shipping price state is aligned to Aug31 H1/forecast availability rather than the earlier Aug20 discovery signal.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
